edges.subject: CLN3
edges.quote: CLN3 Batten disease (also known as juvenile neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis) is a lysosomal storage disorder that typically initiates with retinal degeneration but is followed by seizure onset, motor decline and premature death.

edges.subject: CLN3 disease
edges.object: defective phagocytosis of photoreceptor outer segment
edges.quote: Patient-derived CLN3 disease induced pluripotent stem cell-RPE cells show defective phagocytosis of photoreceptor outer segment (POS).

edges.subject: CLN3Δ7-8/Δ7-8
edges.quote: CLN3Δ7-8/Δ7-8 RPE (CLN3 RPE) displayed decreased POS binding and consequently decreased uptake of POS compared with isogenic control RPE cells.

edges.subject: CLN3Δ7-8/Δ7-8

edges.subject: CLN3Δ7-8/Δ7-8
edges.quote: CLN3Δ7-8/Δ7-8 mutation (which affects ≤85% of patients) affects both RPE and POS and leads to photoreceptor cell loss in CLN3 disease.
